label: Federal cargo insurance minimum, household goods carrier, per motor vehicle
applies: Loss of or damage to household goods carried on any one motor vehicle, for a household goods motor carrier
movesWhen: By rulemaking, on no schedule this corpus holds
note: The aggregate figure for losses at any one time and place is $10,000. This requirement reaches household goods motor carriers alone, so the section states no cargo insurance minimum at all for a general freight carrier - which is why a cargo limit is a contract term rather than a regulatory floor.
author: Aaron Bollinger
